META.bull_strongest_unrefuted: No binary catalyst inside the 1-4wk swing horizon (earnings 63d out) - genuinely rarer and cleaner than the rest of today's board. The bear CONCEDED: 'If forced to rank today's names purely on least binary-event exposure in the swing horizon, META plausibly wins that ranking even while losing on everything else.'
META.bear_strongest_unrefuted: FER@7 = 1.186 is already past the 1.10 invalidation threshold BEFORE initiation with no catalyst to explain it -- AND THE BULL VOLUNTEERED THIS AGAINST ITSELF: 'I cannot reconcile a vol structure already past its own kill-switch with a directional long built on dealer-exposure timing. These are two contradictory reads on the same underlying and I have no evidence that resolves the contradiction in the long's favor.'
META.bear_case_core: A single-signal trade needs a reliable signal. This clears its floor by 1% on a metric that changed sign 4 times in 12 sessions, on a mechanism explicitly unvalidated at this horizon (hedging pressure is intraday-mean-reverting, Baltussen et al. 2021; a positive DEX LEVEL in an up-tape ran -7pp excess). 'No binary catalyst' cuts AGAINST the bull - if earnings is 63d out, what re-rates the stock inside 1-4 weeks? Meanwhile Core PCE, NFP, CPI and FOMC ALL sit inside the horizon: it is not catalyst-free, it is full of MACRO catalysts META does not control. The 94.3% call-share build is ambiguous - a dealer whose DEX just flipped positive is long delta, so the call build may be the DEALER side of that hedge; and the cited corroborator (Nov-20 480P SOLD) is premium selling, i.e. income collection, not conviction.
META.note: TIE at 0.25/0.25. Both sides independently retreated to the same low confidence. The bull explicitly abandoned the fundamentals leg and narrowed to 'a single-signal timing trade'.

MU.bear_strongest_unrefuted: THE CONCESSION INVERTS THE TRADE. The bull conceded the front-tenor IV may be macro-contaminated. But if IV is macro-INFLATED, then implied is too HIGH, not too low - which makes this a vol SALE, not a vol purchase. Separately, trailing RV 97.7% is the TAIL of an already-realized shock: MU is running at 2.3x its own sector (SMH rv20 42.4%), a gap that should COMPRESS over a 27-day hold, not persist. The bull is implicitly underwriting 'trailing 98% is the new normal for 27 more days' - and fundamentals-gate's OWN key_risk says the opposite ('RV could compress if the AI-memory narrative stabilizes first').
MU.bear_case_core: The kink sits on the exact shared 08-28 PCE tenor that got CRM/DG/PANW/PATH/ORCL SKIPPED for 'kink MISLOCATED' - consistency demands the same treatment. VIX 15.45 sits in the LOW tercile (bound 15.9), the regime the fleet's own research flags as SHORT-vol-favourable; SPY VRP is FAIR (+0.0038), so there is no market-wide cheap-vol backdrop to lean on. The position executes into CONTANGO post-hygiene = negative roll ON TOP of the level bet, a structural cost the bull never addressed.

ZS.bull_strongest_unrefuted: days_to_earnings=9 is the BASIS of the thesis, not exposure to it - selling vol into a known, dated binary is the entire category of trade, and treating the earnings date as exposure would be a category error. Two independently-run methodologies converged on the same VRP +0.251 and the same correctly-located kink. The bear conceded this fully.
ZS.bear_strongest_unrefuted: Flat back-month skew is not a caveat, it IS the whole trade. A short-vol seller's compensation IS the skew premium. At ratio 1.007 the chain prices essentially NO left tail - so you collect a normal-distribution premium while carrying an actual earnings-gap distribution. The single worst asymmetry a vol seller can accept. Only 4 of 22 names in today's scan showed a genuine tail bid; ZS was not one of them.
ZS.bear_case_core: The beat-streak argument runs BACKWARDS: four clean beats mean the market has already priced the fifth. Consensus PTs sit 13-27% above spot, so a clean beat may produce NO follow-through while the first miss is priced by nobody - the beat-magnitude distribution and the price-REACTION distribution are different random variables and the pro side conflated them (fundamentals-gate's own key_risks flags this same tension). You would be selling protection to the very participants building it: Step 0 bearish funnel score 4 with dp_distribution + oi_building_puts, 90d cum-flow -$84.61M. NFP lands 2026-09-04, the covering expiry itself. Float 104.85M is the thinnest of the five.
ZS.note: The bear explicitly endorsed the STRUCTURE (iron condor genuinely caps the tail) while rejecting the NAME. Regime guidance 'iron condors in range' is a green light for the structure, not for this name.

cross_cutting_observation: Across all five debates the BULL side volunteered its own strongest counter-argument in three cases (EWZ, META, MU) and conceded the bear's lead point outright in a fourth (NVDA). That is the disconfirmation step working as designed - the additive rubric cannot produce this, which is precisely why the stage exists.
